question: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder is 5280 cm² and its base radius is 21 cm. Find the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder. (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The relation between Volume (V), Curved Surface Area (CSA), and radius (r) of a cylinder is directly given by the formula:

Volume = (CSA × r) ÷ 2

⇒ Volume = (5280 × 21) ÷ 2

⇒ Volume = 2640 × 21

⇒ Volume = 55440

**∴ The correct answer is 55,440 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 5280 cm²

Radius (r) = 21 cm

**Formulas Used:**

CSA = 2πrh

Volume = πr²h

 

 

 

 
 
• 
 
 r = 21 cm
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 h = ?
 
 Curved Surface Area = 5280 sq cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 21 × h = 5280

⇒ 2 × 22 × 3 × h = 5280

⇒ 132 × h = 5280

⇒ h = 5280 ÷ 132 = 40 cm

Now, substitute the value of h to find the volume:

⇒ Volume = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 21 × 21 × 40

⇒ Volume = 22 × 3 × 21 × 40

⇒ Volume = 66 × 840

⇒ Volume = 55440 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 55,440 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

The TSA of a solid cylinder includes the curved surface area plus the area of the two circular bases. Formula: TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder has exactly one-third of the cylinder's volume. Formula: V = (1 ÷ 3)πr²h.

Hollow Cylinder

For a hollow tube with outer radius R and inner radius r, the volume of material used is given by V = πh(R² − r²).
